accepted.behaviour: Two repositories that share a project name and hold work with the same identifiers each lift only their own rows.
accepted.reason: The spec (spec.md:107-110) rejects the project name as the identity of a repository, because two repositories can have the same project name. In the Reference, the attribution indexes use only the ID, and the cursor keys use the project name and the ID. So two such repositories can lift each other's rows, or lose rows. The spec wins; this is a defect in the Reference.
